title: Gritty Strength Back to Basics
author: Steven  M.
desc: Transform your home into a personal gym with the Back to Basics Strength Training program! Over the course of 4 weeks, you’ll engage in 8 dynamic workouts that utilize minimal equipment to build strength and enhance your overall fitness. Each workout can be done with your choice of dumbbells or kettlebells. Each session incorporates essential movements like the Front Squat and Romanian Deadlift, focusing on key muscle groups for a balanced full-body workout. Perfect for all fitness levels, this program will empower you to challenge yourself and track your progress as you lift, push, and pull your way to a stronger you!
